html:
Learning Outcome 

Upon successful completion of this program, participants will be able to: 

  • Acquire essential knowledge and skills to work in the Airline, Travel, and Tourism industry. 
  • Provide expert advice on flights, accommodation, and tour products, ensuring travelers meet all necessary travel requirements. 
  • Enhance customer service and sales skills to effectively advise customers on when and where to travel based on their needs. 
  • Utilize a Global Distribution System (GDS) to create, manage, and modify reservations efficiently. 

How You Will Benefit 

  • Make appropriate travel arrangements and reservations for clients. 
  • Calculate and quote accurate airfares and book tour products. 
  • Manage international travel documentation in accordance with IATA rules and procedures. 
  • Stay on the leading edge of global e-ticketing implementation. 
  • Gain hands-on exposure to Global Distribution Systems (GDS) and online travel platforms. 

Exam Window 

  • March 
  • June 
  • September 
  • December

Who Should Attend 

This course is ideal for individuals aspiring to build or advance their careers in the travel and tourism sector, including: 

  • Students seeking a professional career in the travel industry 
  • Airline personnel looking to expand their skill set 
  • Tour and travel consultants aiming to enhance their professional qualifications 
  • Corporate travel coordinators responsible for making travel arrangements 
  • Travel agency staff, as holding the IATA/UFTAA International Travel and Tourism Foundation Diploma meets one of the requirements toward becoming IATA-accredited agencies
